12hatch_11pool.summary: Hatch at 12, pool at 11, gas after. Standard vs forge expand / 1-gate core; 3rd hatch ~2:30.
12hatch_11pool.risk: 2-gate zealot pressure before lings, cannon rush

overpool.summary: Overlord 9, pool, hatch. Safe vs 2-gate: lings ~2:15 hold zealots with drones.

12pool.summary: Pool at 12, hatch after. Middle ground: lings ~2:40, decent economy.

3hatch_muta.summary: Mid-game transition: 3 hatch, lair, spire, mutalisk harass vs 1-base or slow-corsair Protoss.

2hatch_muta.summary: Mid-game transition: 2 hatch, fast lair/spire. Vs sair/DT or when 3rd hatch is unsafe.

3hatch_hydra.summary: Mid-game transition: hydra den, range/speed, 5-hatch hydra timing vs forge FE / sair-reaver.

lurker_contain.summary: Lurkers to hold the natural and 3rd vs zealot/goon pressure, buys time for 4-5 bases.

reference_timings.forge: 1:00-1:20 = forge FE (cannons at natural), can go 3 hatch greedy
reference_timings.nexus: 2nd nexus 1:40-2:30 = fast expand; later = 1-base tech or 2-gate
reference_timings.photon_cannon: 1:40-2:30 at natural = FE; in our base = cannon rush
